openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: One of the first cheap devices with an gigabit Ethernet switch. Advertised features: 3 removable omni antennas (RP-SMA connectors) and 24 dBm (251 mW, v1.x)/25 dBm (v2.x, v3.x) maximal TX power output. Note: Maximal TX power and available channels are limited in some countries!

Historic information v4.0.Supported since: v4 Snapshot from 2017-02-19 was working without problems
Historic information v4.0.Model Specific Notes: New UI and HW changes. Got QCA9563 + 16MB internal flash (QCA9563+QCA8337N+25Q128FVSG+A3R12E40CBF-8E) FCC ID: TE7WR1043NDV4 (https://fccid.io/TE7WR1043NDV4)

openwrt_wiki.Hardware-Tabelle: Spalten HW ver. 1.x, 2.x, 5.x; keine v4-Spalte. Switch-Zeile für 5.x: Qualcomm Atheros QCA8337-AL3C; Flash-Chip 5.x: Winbond 25Q128FVSG
openwrt_wiki.TFTP-Recovery allgemein: reset button (in the hole besides the power adapter hole) pressed while connecting power; 'The v4 file needs to be named wr1043ndv4_tp_recovery.bin.'
openwrt_wiki.Serial: TTL 3.3V; Bits per second 115200, Data bits 8, Parity None, Stop bits 1, Flow control None; Lötbild nur für V1.X und V2.X (Bild tl-wr1043nd_serial_pinouts.jpg)
openwrt_wiki.Power Consumption: With a cheap Wattmeter i measured 6.9 W idle and 9 W under load. (HW-Version nicht genannt)

mach-tl-wr1043nd-v4.c.Copyright: P. Wassi, Matthias Schiffer, Andreas Ziegler, Ludwig Thomeczek; Derived from: mach-dir-869-a1.c
mach-tl-wr1043nd-v4.c.GPIO: BTN_RESET 2, BTN_RFKILL 5, LED_WLAN 19, LED_USB 7, LED_WPS 1, LED_SYSTEM 6, USB_POWER 8, LED_WAN 15, LED_LAN1 9, LED_LAN2 14, LED_LAN3 21, LED_LAN4 20

openwrt_git_ar71xx.Device/tl-wr1043nd-v4: DEVICE_TITLE := TP-LINK TL-WR1043N/ND v4; DEVICE_PACKAGES := kmod-usb-core kmod-usb2 kmod-usb-ledtrig-usbport; BOARDNAME := TL-WR1043ND-v4; TPLINK_HWID := 0x10430004; TPLINK_FLASHLAYOUT := 16Msafeloader; MTDPARTS := spi0.0:128k(u-boot)ro,1536k(kernel),14016k(rootfs),128k(product-info)ro,320k(config)ro,64k(partition-table)ro,128k(logs)ro,64k(ART)ro,15552k@0x20000(firmware); IMAGE_SIZE := 15552k; TPLINK_BOARD_NAME := TLWR1043NDV4; IMAGES := sysupgrade.bin factory.bin

openwrt_git_firmware_utils.message: firmware-utils: add support for TL-WR1043ND v4 to mktplinkfw and tplink-safeloader - The TL-WR1043ND v4 uses a kernel image with a mktplinkfw header inside the os-image partition of a tplink-safeloader image.

openwrt_git_mac.message: ar71xx: fix MAC addresses on TP-Link TL-WR1043ND v4 - addresses were read from the 'config' partition, which would not always contain the addresses at the same offsets, depending on the stock firmware version used before flashing LEDE. Change this to get the addresses from the 'product-info' partition, which is read-only.

openwrt_git_ath79.message: ath79: add tl-wr1043nd-v4 support everything is working - tplink-safeloader: resize kernel partition, kernel 4.14 is much bigger

openwrt_git_ath79_fixes.message: ath79: small wr1043nd-v4 fixes - fix sysupgrade check; move usb to v4 dts because v5 doesn't have it; make wan mac address behave like ar71xx target; add orange wan led support (userspace)

openwrt_git_dts_move.message: ath79: Move settings specific for TP-Link TL-WR1043ND v4 to DTS - This prepares for support of v5.
